title: Glowing piano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE066' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8B4513'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5C2E0A'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lidGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#A0522D'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6B3410'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ambient glow behind piano -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='48' ry='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- piano body -->
  <rect x='12' y='38' width='76' height='38' rx='4' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- body top edge highlight -->
  <rect x='12' y='38' width='76' height='3' rx='2' fill='#CD853F'/>

  <!-- raised lid -->
  <path d='M12 38 L16 18 L84 18 L88 38 Z' fill='url(#lidGrad)'/>
  <path d='M16 18 L84 18 L83 21 L17 21 Z' fill='#CD853F' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- lid hinge line -->
  <line x1='16' y1='20' x2='84' y2='20' stroke='#E8B878' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- music stand -->
  <rect x='32' y='22' width='36' height='10' rx='2' fill='#3A1A05'/>
  <rect x='34' y='24' width='32' height='6' rx='1' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.25'/>

  <!-- white keys -->
  <rect x='15' y='62' width='70' height='12' rx='1' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
  <!-- key separators -->
  <line x1='25' y1='62' x2='25' y2='74' stroke='#D4C4A8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='62' x2='35' y2='74' stroke='#D4C4A8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='45' y1='62' x2='45' y2='74' stroke='#D4C4A8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='62' x2='55' y2='74' stroke='#D4C4A8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='62' x2='65' y2='74' stroke='#D4C4A8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='75' y1='62' x2='75' y2='74' stroke='#D4C4A8' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- black keys (deep purple-blue, clearly lit) -->
  <rect x='21' y='62' width='5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#3D2B6B'/>
  <rect x='31' y='62' width='5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#3D2B6B'/>
  <rect x='46' y='62' width='5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#3D2B6B'/>
  <rect x='56' y='62' width='5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#3D2B6B'/>
  <rect x='66' y='62' width='5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#3D2B6B'/>

  <!-- black key highlights -->
  <rect x='21.5' y='62.5' width='1.5' height='5' rx='0.5' fill='#6B5BB5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <rect x='31.5' y='62.5' width='1.5' height='5' rx='0.5' fill='#6B5BB5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <rect x='46.5' y='62.5' width='1.5' height='5' rx='0.5' fill='#6B5BB5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <rect x='56.5' y='62.5' width='1.5' height='5' rx='0.5' fill='#6B5BB5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <rect x='66.5' y='62.5' width='1.5' height='5' rx='0.5' fill='#6B5BB5' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- keybed front -->
  <rect x='15' y='74' width='70' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5C2E0A'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='18' y='76' width='6' height='14' rx='1' fill='#4A2408'/>
  <rect x='76' y='76' width='6' height='14' rx='1' fill='#4A2408'/>

  <!-- pedals -->
  <rect x='44' y='86' width='4' height='6' rx='1' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <rect x='52' y='86' width='4' height='6' rx='1' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <rect x='43.5' y='86' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFD700' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='51.5' y='86' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFD700' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- glowing notes (Doot's glow colour) -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.9'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='30' rx='4' ry='4' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.2'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='24' r='2' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.9'/>
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='24' rx='3.5' ry='3.5' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.2'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='20' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.15'/>

  <!-- note stems and flags -->
  <line x1='82' y1='30' x2='82' y2='22' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='90' y1='24' x2='90' y2='16' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M90 16 Q93 17 92 20' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M8 28 L9 26 L10 28 L9 30 Z' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M92 50 L93.5 47 L95 50 L93.5 53 Z' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M6 55 L7 53 L8 55 L7 57 Z' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- warm glow on keys -->
  <rect x='15' y='62' width='70' height='12' rx='1' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.08'/>
</svg>
